units.source_text: 此诗袭用古歌中“何曾如此湿青衫”之意，是老生常谈。

en.t: This poem borrows the idea from an old poem, asking when one's blue robe was ever so wet with tears; it is a familiar commonplace.

units.source_text: 大约匂亲王以为聊胜于无，所以勉强咏成此诗。

en.t: Prince Niou probably thought it was better than sending nothing, and so forced himself to compose this poem.

units.source_text: 大女公子越发觉得可恨了。

en.t: The elder princess found him all the more hateful.

units.source_text: 然而匂亲王是个世间稀有的美男子，加之为欲引人注目，常常装出风流俊俏之相。

en.t: Yet Prince Niou was an exceptionally handsome man, rare in the world, and because he wished to draw attention, he often affected an elegant and charming appearance.

units.source_text: 故年轻的二女公子被他迷住，亦属当然之理。

en.t: It was therefore only natural that the young younger princess should be captivated by him.

units.source_text: 一别多时，不免使她恋念。

en.t: After being parted from him for so long, she could not help longing for him.

units.source_text: 她常常回心转意，想道：“他曾对我立下如此恳挚的山盟海誓，无论如何总不会就此断缘吧。”

en.t: She often changed her mind again and thought, "He once made such earnest vows to me; surely he would not break off our bond like this, whatever happens."

units.source_text: 匂亲王的使者催索回信，说“今夜必须返命”。

en.t: Prince Niou's messenger pressed for a reply, saying, "I must return with an answer tonight."

units.source_text: 经众侍女劝请，二女公子仅答复了一首诗：

en.t: At the urging of her attendants, the younger princess answered only with a single poem:
